company.name: Eventtus
company.shortDescription: Eventtus is an engagement platform to manage events, sell tickets and build an interactive event app in few minutes.
company.description:
Eventtus provides a one stop shop for event organizers to manage their events, in few minutes they can add their event’s information, create a web page for the event, sell the tickets and build a beautiful mobile app for the event with agenda, speakers bios, live announcements, realtime polling and a networking platform for all attendees.

For attendees Eventtus is their personal mobile app for events, it’s the one app they’ll need for all events. It includes all events' information like full schedule, speakers and even attendee opinion polls, right in their pockets. They can interact with the sessions and speakers, start meaningful conversations and exchange contacts with other attendees through the app directly.
